document: R2d (i) calibration + (ii) parsed-action identity — 理, pre-registered
R2c_stays_failed: results/r2c_held.json is VOID and is not reopened. R2d is a new gate.
(i) how to read it: ~100% => raw-text identity IS achievable on this hardware, and R2c's 33/40 is attributable to the cache. ~80% => raw-text identity is a property of greedy bf16 decoding and R2c's gate was an instrument that could not pass. Printed either way; it interprets (ii) and gates nothing by itself.
(iii): NOT IN THIS FILE — paired outcomes need the agent wired to the shared cache.
VERDICT: (ii) FAILS — the shared cache changed the agent's action on 5 of 300 decisions
bounds: (ii) compares the FIRST post-inspect decision of each episode, which is where the head acts. It does not re-run whole episodes; that is (iii).
A parsed-action match is (action, region, bug_class). The free-text `why` is NOT compared, by design -- the harness never reads it.

REGION_IDENTITY__the_field_the_HEAD_actu.note: all 5 mismatches differ ONLY in bug_class; the region is the same in every one (gather/gather x3, fold/fold, shape/shape). The region is what the head picks and what the localisation metric scores; bug_class is the agent's own downstream choice.
REGION_IDENTITY__the_field_the_HEAD_actu.⛔ THIS DOES NOT RESCUE THE GATE: 理 set (ii) as parsed-action identity including bug_class. It reads 295/300 and it FAILS. This is recorded as the SHAPE of the failure, not as an argument for reading it differently -- that argument would be the same after-the-fact relaxation R2c was already refused for.

VERDICT_FINAL: R2d FAILS at (ii). Per 理 'FAIL any -> premium stands, and the paper says the cache changes the agent.' (iii) is NOT run: it is moot. 8a's cost sentence is unchanged from R2, R2b and R2c -- G buys success at a compute premium.
WHAT_THE_CALIBRATION_SETTLES: (i) read 40/40 = 100%. Raw-text identity IS achievable on this hardware with identical inputs, so the divergence is NOT greedy decoding being nondeterministic -- it is the shared cache. The control was pre-registered to let the old gate off if it could never have passed; it did the opposite, and that is reported as readily as the other reading would have been.
